touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Norton in Hales qualifies as a local detour through Churchyard cross, St Chad's Church and CHURCH OF SAINT CHAD AND ATTACHED ARCHWAY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Norton in Hales: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Norton in Hales offers Churchyard cross, St Chad's Church, CHURCH OF SAINT CHAD AND ATTACHED ARCHWAY, CHURCHYARD CROSS APPROXIMATELY 5 METRES TO SOUTH OF SOUTH AISLE OF CHURCH OF SAINT CHAD within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
